instincts.trigger: Firebase auth/invalid-api-key error during SSR or build
instincts.action: Guard Firebase service initialization with `typeof window !== 'undefined'` and export null for server context

instincts.trigger: E2E test failure with selector not found, especially after landing page redesign
instincts.action: Check if tests reference old AuthWrapper fallback text. The landing page now renders full LandingSections for unauthenticated users via app/page.tsx — update selectors to match actual rendered elements

instincts.trigger: TypeScript error: Cannot find name 'NextConfig' in next.config.ts
instincts.action: Add `import type { NextConfig } from 'next'` at top of next.config.ts

instincts.trigger: Next.js 16+ build error about experimental.turbo resolveAlias
Permission-denied on Firestore write immediately after user login
instincts.action: Call `await u.getIdToken()` before first write and wrap getDoc in retryGetDoc with exponential backoff

instincts.trigger: Playwright test fails due to Firebase popup blocking or ad blocker interference
instincts.action: Use signInWithPopup (more reliable than redirect) and add retry/timeout for auth flows. Add `firebase` and `auth/` to error filters in console-error tests

instincts.trigger: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE set but Firebase still initializes in browser
instincts.action: Ensure `isDemo` condition also checks `!useEnv` — remove `!useEnv` check so demo mode works even if env vars partially exist, OR set all NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* vars to empty strings
